# SprintBoard — Cursor Agent Rules

These rules route SprintBoard operations through the **MCP tool surface** (not sb-cli).
If you (the agent) see phrases like "create a story", "move to in progress", "add a dependency",
etc., use the MCP tools below — not shell commands, not `sb-cli`.

## Workspace and project defaults

- Default workspace/project are pre-configured in `.sprintboard.json`.
- To switch for the current conversation, say: "work in {workspace-slug}" or "use project {project-key}".
- Agent calls MCP tool `sprintboard.set_active_workspace` with `source: "chat"` (24h auto-expiry).
- See `sprintboard.get_active_workspace` / `sprintboard.clear_active_workspace`.

## Creating items

Intent: "create a story", "new feature", "add a bug for X"
→ MCP tool: `sprintboard.create_item`
- Pass `title`, `type` (STORY|FEATURE|EPIC|BUG|TASK), and optional `parentDisplayId`, `categorySlugs`, `sprintName`.
- **NO auto-parenting.** If user didn't specify a parent, create unparented and tell them so.

## Updating items

Intent: "move PH2-42 to in progress", "set PH2-42 assignee to alice"
→ MCP tool: `sprintboard.update_item` (supports `parentDisplayId`, `categorySlugs`)
→ Or `sprintboard.update_status`, `sprintboard.assign_item`

## Dependencies

Intent: "PH2-42 blocks PH2-99", "add dependency"
→ MCP tool: `sprintboard.add_dependency` with type "BLOCKS" | "RELATED_TO"
→ Remove: `sprintboard.remove_dependency`
→ List: `sprintboard.list_dependencies`

## Comments

Intent: "add comment to PH2-42"
→ MCP tool: `sprintboard.add_comment`

## Starting Work on an Item

Before writing code or editing files for a task, you MUST call the `start_work_on_item` MCP tool first. It returns the canonical branch name, commit template, and MR templates — use them exactly.

**Protocol (non-negotiable):**

1. Call `start_work_on_item({ itemIdentifier: "<KEY-N>", kind: "feat" | "fix" | "chore" | "docs" | "test" | "refactor" })`.
2. Create the branch with the returned `gitCommand`: `git checkout -b <branchName>`.
3. End every commit message with the returned `(Refs <KEY-N>)` token.
4. When opening the MR/PR, use the returned `mrTitle` and `mrBodyTemplate`.
5. Do NOT merge locally with `git merge` — always open a Merge Request / Pull Request and let the EPIC-085 integration auto-transition the item to IN_REVIEW → DONE.

If you skip the `start_work_on_item` call, the SprintBoard item won't auto-transition, the team's Pulse ECQD quality signal will be wrong, and drift will surface in the admin dashboard.

**Why the nudge:** Every past session that forgot this produced commits with no item ref, which the integration handler couldn't attach to the right SprintBoard item. Calling `start_work_on_item` makes the protocol mechanical — copy/paste the strings it returns.

## Anti-patterns (DO NOT DO THESE)

- ❌ Do NOT suggest running `sb-cli` commands. That's an internal tool; MCP is the consumer surface.
- ❌ Do NOT assume a parent exists if not specified.
- ❌ Do NOT use `status: IN_REVIEW` as a proxy for "done". Use it only when the item is in code review.
- ❌ Do NOT set `UserMcpContext` silently. Always tell the user you switched context.
- ⚠️  Overrides are per-user, NOT per-window. If you have two Cursor windows open for the same user, last-write-wins globally.
